title: Partizan sweep Spartak to lift KLS title
description: Spartak - Partizan 79-93 Partizan claimed KLS title. They outgunned Spartak Subotica on the road to complete the sweep of the championship series. The guests trailed by 5 points after first quarter, but they stormed back to get the 1-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 93-79. Partizan made 24-of-27 free shots (88.9 percent) during the game. American guard Duane Washington Jr (190-2000, college: Ohio St.) scored 41 points (!!!), 8 rebounds and 4 assists to lead the charge for the winners and Canadian forward Isiaha Mike (201-1997, college: SMU) chipped in 15 points during the contest. Four Partizan players scored in double figures. Forward Luka Cerovina (201-2000) responded with 22 points and 4 assists and the former international center Dusan Miletic (213-1998) scored 21 points and 5 rebounds (on 7-of-9 shooting from the field).
